title: gardenia edulis
intro: Gardenia edulis, commonly known as the Cape ginger or yellow gardenia, is a plant species native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and it is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to aid in digestion and relieve inflammation. The health benefits of Gardenia edulis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Gardenia edulis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
